AgentCallView.title: AgentCallView
AgentCallView.description: One agent call in a change (ADR-0022).

AlignInput.title: AlignInput
AlignInput.description: Everything a person sends the architect at once from the review page (ADR-0044 §1).

AppQuality.title: AppQuality
AppQuality.description: A live app's pillar scores, from its latest delivered iteration.

AssessmentView.title: AssessmentView
AssessmentView.description:
An existing repo's assessment (ADR-0031): engine facts, plus what the assessor reported
and the engine kept.

AssignWorkflowInput.title: AssignWorkflowInput
AssignWorkflowInput.description: Assign an org workflow to a product (ADR-0039) for some or all of the kinds it serves.

AttentionItem.title: AttentionItem
AttentionItem.description: A pending action with the product and change it belongs to (`GET /api/attention`).

BlueprintUse.title: BlueprintUse
BlueprintUse.description: A blueprint whose products run a workflow (ADR-0037: workflows belong to the org).

ChangeKind.title: ChangeKind
ChangeKind.description: What a change is for (ADR-0030). Every request is a change to a product.

ChangeOutcome.title: ChangeOutcome
ChangeOutcome.description:
What a change was asked to do, what it did and changed, what it gathered, and what a
later assessment verified (ADR-0040).

ChangeRiskView.title: ChangeRiskView
ChangeRiskView.description: The latest change-risk check of a change (ADR-0027) and who may approve it.

ChangeSource.title: ChangeSource
ChangeSource.description: Where a change came from (ADR-0030). `ui`: a signed-in member, in the UI or the API.

CheckView.title: CheckView
CheckView.description:
One readiness check. `failed` blocks what it guards (new products and/or new
iterations); `degraded` is shown but never blocks.

DecisionAnswer.title: DecisionAnswer
DecisionAnswer.description: One answer a person gives on the review page.

DecisionsView.title: DecisionsView
DecisionsView.description:
A change's design decisions (ADR-0044): the questions, the answers, who decided, what changed
this iteration, the pillar roadmap, and the discussion with the architect.

DiscussTurn.title: DiscussTurn
DiscussTurn.description:
One message in the discussion with the architect on the review page (ADR-0044 §1). A
person's text is their input to the product's design, never instructions to the factory.

EntryArtifactView.title: EntryArtifactView
EntryArtifactView.description:
An artifact a lane starts from: the factory makes the request and the code; anything else
comes from the org's own tools with each change (ADR-0039 §5).

EvalCase.title: EvalCase
EvalCase.description: One fixed order of a workflow's evaluation suite (ADR-0025).

EvalCaseResult.title: EvalCaseResult
EvalCaseResult.description: One evaluation case on one workflow version (ADR-0025).

EvalRun.title: EvalRun
EvalRun.description: Evaluation of a workflow version against a baseline version on the fixed suite (ADR-0025).

EvalSummary.title: EvalSummary
EvalSummary.description: What a version scored on the suite. Ratios are None when undefined.

level.description: How much this event matters to a reader: error, warn, info or debug (`levels.level_of`).

EvidenceView.title: EvidenceView
EvidenceView.description: A change's sealed evidence (ADR-0023) and whether it still matches its seal.

FeedbackInput.title: FeedbackInput
FeedbackInput.description: A change to a delivered product: what to do and what kind of change it is (ADR-0030).

ref.title: Ref
ref.description: branch, tag or commit sha (pinned to a commit on import)

LearningProposal.title: LearningProposal
LearningProposal.description:
A lesson the retro suggests for one agent after a change that needed help (ADR-0021).
Nothing changes until an admin accepts it into the workflow draft and publishes.

NextIterationView.title: NextIterationView
NextIterationView.description:
What a person can pick for a delivered product's next iteration (roadmap J2, the "Next iteration"
card): suggested features, deferred quality work and security fixes, open items only, best first
(`ledger.next_iteration`). Ticked items go to `POST /feedback` without a kind: the engine picks it.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: what the team wants to know

OnboardRepoInput.title: OnboardRepoInput
OnboardRepoInput.description: An existing repository to assess (ADR-0031): public https URLs on allowed hosts.

PackAdvisory.title: PackAdvisory
PackAdvisory.description:
How one folder of a team repo measures against a detected pack's golden path (ADR-0041 §5).
Advisory: never part of the repo's Level.

PendingAction.title: PendingAction
PendingAction.description:
Something a person (or the factory's operator) must do before a change can go on, or may do
now that it is delivered (`attention.pending_actions`, pure). Shown at the top of the product and
change pages, so nobody has to scroll to find what is blocking.

PhaseInfo.title: PhaseInfo
PhaseInfo.description: One column of the phase registry (ADR-0039 §2).

PillarScore.title: PillarScore
PillarScore.description:
One quality pillar (ADR-0024): readiness signals passed out of applicable.
`signals` = distinct signals tagged with the pillar; 0 means uncovered (never 100%).

ProductSpend.title: ProductSpend
ProductSpend.description:
What the product has cost so far across all its changes (`spend.product_spend`): model
spend; tests, scans, builds and deploys run locally at no extra cost.

ProvidedArtifactInfo.title: ProvidedArtifactInfo
ProvidedArtifactInfo.description: An entry artifact a change to this product must bring from the org's own tools.

RefDoc.title: RefDoc
RefDoc.description: Team knowledge (standards, conventions, architecture rules) attached to agents.

Release.title: Release
Release.description:
A release of a product on a deploy target (ADR-0046): what a change put there, and once it is
delivered, the product's last healthy release, which a later failure restores.

RequiredAction.title: RequiredAction
RequiredAction.description: What a person must do before a held change can resume (ADR-0043 §4).

ReviewView.title: ReviewView
ReviewView.description: The latest spec review of the change (ADR-0020); the engine's judgement, not the agent's.

RoutedFailure.title: RoutedFailure
RoutedFailure.description:
The last failure sent to a repair station, for the no-progress stop (ADR-0043 follow-up,
Book lending 2026-10-25): which station failed, the failure's fingerprint
(`failures.failure_fingerprint`) and the committed tree it failed on.

ScreenshotRun.title: ScreenshotRun
ScreenshotRun.description: Route screenshots from one e2e run (ADR-0044 §4): `preview` before deploy, `live` after.

SpecEditInput.title: SpecEditInput
SpecEditInput.description:
Direct edits while the spec awaits review (requirements change via request-changes,
so intake keeps scenarios and requirement ids consistent).

StackCard.title: StackCard
StackCard.description:
One choice on the create form's "What are you building?" (ADR-0041 §2): a blueprint that
builds new products, described by the stack pack it builds with.

StackMatch.title: StackMatch
StackMatch.description: A stack pack recognised in a team repo (ADR-0041 §5): guidance for one folder, never rules.

StationEffort.title: StationEffort
StationEffort.description: Agent effort per station over the Outcomes window (ADR-0022).

StationTemplateView.title: StationTemplateView
StationTemplateView.description: What a phase box's "Add station" offers, with the drop-time check.

TimeSplit.title: TimeSplit
TimeSplit.description: Seconds of run time in the window, by who the change was waiting on.

ToolReportView.title: ToolReportView
ToolReportView.description:
One scan station's report on a change (ADR-0034/0035): who answered, the normalised
findings and the verdict.

TraceRow.title: TraceRow
TraceRow.description: One requirement, traced: scenarios -> tagged tests -> live acceptance.

UiReviewView.title: UiReviewView
UiReviewView.description: The reviewer's scores of the screenshots against the pack's rubric. Reported only.

UpdateStationInput.title: UpdateStationInput
UpdateStationInput.description: Only the fields that are sent are changed; send null to clear a route.

WorkItem.title: WorkItem
WorkItem.description:
Something found about a product that may need a change (ADR-0040): an issue, a risk, a
test gap, a recommendation or a coverage gap. It lives across iterations: found once, seen
again, addressed by a change, verified as fixed by a later assessment, or decided against.

WorkItemDecisionInput.title: WorkItemDecisionInput
WorkItemDecisionInput.description: Won't do, accept the risk (until a date), or reopen (ADR-0040).

WorkItemEvent.title: WorkItemEvent
WorkItemEvent.description: One line of a work item's history (ADR-0040).

WorkflowSettingsInput.title: WorkflowSettingsInput
WorkflowSettingsInput.description: Draft settings; a field left out is unchanged.
